notes.id: Tiny Tots setengah hari. Biaya tahunan all-inclusive (dana pengembangan, sumber belajar, tuition). Registrasi Rp500.000; enrolment siswa baru Rp15 juta; deposit Rp10 juta (dapat dikembalikan). Dihimpun Lokalfinds dari jadwal biaya resmi sekolah (Juli 2026).
notes.en: Tiny Tots half day. All-inclusive annual fees (development fund, resources, tuition). Registration Rp500,000; new-student enrolment Rp15M; refundable deposit Rp10M. Compiled by Lokalfinds from the school's official fee schedule (July 2026).

source.title: International Schools in Bali: Official 2026 Fees (Lokalfinds)
